MYTHS.Definition: ideas that many people believe but that are not true

CLEAR UP.Definition: explain so that it is no longer confusing

STRESS.Definition: the extra force put on one part of a word when saying it

NECESSARILY.Definition: in every case; as an automatic result

SPEECH DEFECT.Definition: a physical or medical problem that makes it hard to speak clearly

SUBCONSCIOUS.Definition: happening in the mind without the person being aware of it

BIAS.Definition: an unfair tendency to favour or dislike some people

TRUSTWORTHY.Definition: able to be believed and relied on

COMPONENT.Definition: separate, together making up the whole

LIPS.Definition: the two soft edges around the opening of your mouth

MIMICKING.Definition: copying the way someone speaks or behaves

IMITATING.Definition: copying closely; doing in the same way as

CLASSIFY.Definition: describe as belonging to a particular type

END OF.Definition: and there is nothing more to say about it

ACKNOWLEDGING.Definition: accepting or admitting that something is true

ACTIONABLE.Definition: practical, so that you can use it to make changes

PAT ON THE BACK.Definition: show of praise for doing something well

IN THE INTERESTS OF.Definition: in order to help achieve; for the purpose of

MANAGEABLE.Definition: reasonable; not too long or difficult to deal with
